name: Permission Misconfiguration Reconnaissance Via Findstr.EXE
description:
Detects usage of findstr with the "EVERYONE" or "BUILTIN" keywords.
This was seen being used in combination with "icacls" and other utilities to spot misconfigured files or folders permissions.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (((process.executable:(*\\find.exe OR *\\findstr.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(FIND.EXE OR FINDSTR.EXE))) AND (process.command_line:(*\"Everyone\"* OR *'Everyone'* OR *\"BUILTIN\\\"* OR *'BUILTIN\\'*))) OR (process.command_line:*icacls\ * AND process.command_line:*findstr\ * AND process.command_line:*Everyone*)
